observation_reviews.rationale: From the trxd round; fix carried unchanged (no FX column differs trzd vs trxd). Quote is printed and shows a dollar par with no currency cell. The proposed detector (non-USD principal unit whose printed row lacks that currency code) is concrete and uses data the bridge already holds; false positives limited to rows with no printed par (the report names one, Speed Midco undrawn '-'), which the check should skip.

Section-total-by-class comparison is concrete and recurrence-catching; false positives only where a filer's section totals mix classes, which the comparison would surface rather than hide.

Measured trzb page_rule_findings: 3,314 issuer_name_printed rows for this fund (13 fund-quarter findings) against 11 in trza, so the wrapper setting broke nearly every name, a larger effect than the report's '5 to 13' wording suggests. Reverting was correct. existing_detector holds: issuer_name_printed fired on every damaged row, so a recurrence cannot pass silently.
